title: The Fourth, 2018 · the receipt
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Two days after: a diner receipt from Newport, 2 AM, ten days old, on the drafting table under the lamp, two coffees and a pie, and Wood not throwing it out and not pinning it. It goes in the drawer with the pins and the bulb. The strip inventories the drawer.

panels.composition: The garage. A diner receipt on the drafting table under the lamp. WOOD looking at it. The PUP.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a small diner receipt on a drafting table under a lamp with a thin man looking down at it and a small three-legged dog nearby

panels.composition: The receipt, close: two coffees, one pie, 2:14 AM. The name of the diner not legible.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, close on a diner receipt listing two coffees and a slice of pie with a time in the small hours, the header illegible

panels.composition: WOOD opening the drawer: pushpins, a tin, tape, a lightbulb from 2007.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, an open desk drawer holding pushpins, a tin, tape and an old lightbulb in its sleeve

panels.composition: The receipt going in on top. The drawer closing.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a man's hand placing a receipt into a drawer and sliding it shut

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: Newport, 2 AM (dw_2018-06-24). The drawer inventory: pins, tin, tape, the 2007 bulb, the receipt.
